_help: Which data the daily update pulls from the NCAA API (https://github.com/henrygd/ncaa-api).
Each path matches a page on ncaa.com: open the page in your browser and copy everything after ncaa.com.
Stat categories: go to https://www.ncaa.com/stats/<sport>/<division>, pick a category from the dropdown,
and copy its number from the URL, e.g. .../current/individual/750 -> 750.
Lacrosse is in its offseason until February, so its stats are last season's until then.
